Let's work through the chain starting at ffg.

The first pair is (ffg, uvw). The first item of the first pair is ffg, so the next pair in the chain is the one whose first item is ffg: (fgf, uvw). Its second item is uvw, but uvw never appears as a first item - so uvw is the dangling end of the chain.

The second pair is (fgf, uvw). The first item of the first pair is fgf, so the next pair in the chain is the one whose first item is fgf: (fgf, gvw). Its second item is gvw, but gvw never appears as a first item - so gvw is the dangling end of the chain.

The third pair is (fgf, gvw).
